question.text: In India, equity and index options traded on NSE and BSE are of which style?

answer.text: European style - can be exercised only on the expiry date
American style - can be exercised any time before expiry
Index options are European and stock options are American
Stock options are European and index options are American

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook defines American options as exercisable any time up to and including the expiration date, and European options as exercisable only on the expiration date. It then states that all index options and stock options traded on Indian exchanges are European style, so exercise happens only on expiry. The Trap: Many learners assume stock options must be American because some overseas markets allow early exercise. On Indian exchanges, both index and stock options follow the European style. Note: India = all exchange-traded options are European style. Exercise is permitted only on the expiration date.
